about_the_game:
A deep psychological horror set in the nihilistic world of Cotard Syndrome. Your critical decisions across four chapters determine which of seven unique endings you unlock. Every playthrough offers new discoveries and confrontations.

Features

  • Psychological Terror: Immerse yourself in the unsettling delusions of Cotard Syndrome

  • 4 Chapters: Progress through increasingly intense, atmospheric scenarios

  • 7 Endings: Your choices directly shape who survives—and how the story concludes

  • Choice-Driven Mechanics: Every decision branches the narrative in profound ways

  • High Replayability: Experiment with different choices to uncover hidden details and endings

Make your choices, face the void, and write your own reality in the emptiness of Cotard.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10+
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-4170
  • Graphics: Nvidia 6800 or ATI X1300 or Intel HD3000
  • Storage: 500 MB available space

short_description: Cotard Sendromu’nun karanlık delüzyonlarında kaybolacağınız 4 bölümlük psikolojik korku macerası. Verdiğiniz kritik seçimlerle 7 farklı sona ulaşın. Her oynanışta yeni sırlar ve tüyler ürperten hesaplaşmalar sizi bekliyor.
supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Simplified Chinese, Portuguese - Brazil, Japanese, Korean, Turkish
